user.title: Connect to the family screen
user.description: Enter the family screen's IP address (shown in the app under Parent mode → Pairing) and the family parent PIN.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Lommepenge found
zeroconf_confirm.description: The family screen "{name}" ({host}) was found on the network. Confirm with the family parent PIN.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect
reauth_confirm.description: The connection was revoked in the app. Confirm with the parent PIN to reconnect.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the family screen. Check the IP address and that the app is open on the screen.
error.too_many_attempts: Too many wrong PIN attempts. Wait a minute and try again.

abort.already_configured: This family screen is already set up.
abort.wrong_screen: The PIN belongs to a different family screen.

approve.name: Approve task
approve.description: Approves a completed task so the amount is added to the child's balance.

completion_id.name: Completion ID
completion_id.description: ID from the lommepenge_event event or the "Awaiting approval" sensor.

reject.name: Reject task
reject.description: Rejects a completed task. The child has to do it again.

suspend_restriction.name: Lift restriction today
suspend_restriction.description: Lifts the child's restriction for the rest of today.

child_id.name: Child ID
child_id.description: The child_id attribute of the child's "Tablet restricted" sensor.
